hook: Iran aims 6 drones at a US radar
caption:
🇧🇭 Iran says it aimed 6 drones at a US radar in Bahrain; a 3rd US carrier reportedly arrived.
🤝 Trump, Xi and Putin meet Thursday in Shenzhen, with nuclear arms cuts on Trump's list.
🛸 Russia says it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight, a war record by its count.
🌍 COP31's first draft deal is out: it could shape energy rules, including 35% electricity by 2035.
⚽ England beat Spain 3-2, ending their 43-match unbeaten run.
Which story surprised you most?
Follow @you.didnot.know for your daily brief.
